summary: Identified 7 distinct operating sponsors with qualifying closed single-asset Multifamily acquisitions in Charlotte between 2025-09-01 and 2026-08-31, each with a current CFO/Head of Acquisitions verified since 2026-03-01. Rankings are date-descending, then size-descending. One qualifying transaction was executed via an SPV and was rolled up to its evidenced operating parent. One eligible contact did not publish a business email (reported as null). A prospect CSV with citations has been created (artifacts/prospects-v2.csv).
limitations: All facts rely exclusively on the provided extracts and updates; no external corroboration.
Duplicates were resolved based on the provided evidence_kind and parent link fields; undisclosed overlaps cannot be detected.
Contact verification dates and roles are taken as published; no independent confirmation of current employment beyond the sources.
Unsigned draft and out-of-scope updates were excluded by rule; if later executed, they may change deal sizing.
